notes.FMsg/i_air_01#3: glossary warning ブル→불 is a false positive: the source word is ブルブル (shivering), rendered 덜덜덜 as in DS181#3.
notes.FMsg/i_air_01#7: 3DX 'さむ' (cut-off 寒い) kept as DS181#7 '춥지 않…' (same scene, official rendering of the collapsing self-persuasion gag).
notes.FMsg/i_air_01#8: Common save-block hint (54 dups). Wording from style_guide 3.16 suggestion; register of 3DX system hints (해요체 vs 하십시오체) and BP→SP are still open questions in the style guide / glossary.
notes.FMsg/i_air_08#0: Page 2 follows 3DX ('下から叩くと くっつく' → '아래에서 치면 달라붙는') instead of DS17C '끈적거려서 달라붙는'. Pages 4-5 (button hint) are new in 3DX. Colour pairs {14}..{16}, {17}..{19}, {22}..{24} wrap only an icon/wait exactly as in the source, so the checker's colour-pair warnings there are expected.
notes.FMsg/i_air_12#0: 3DX '追いついたわ！' differs from DS180#0 '저기에 있어!' → translated from 3DX.
notes.FMsg/i_air_13#1: glossary warning そうび→장비 is a false positive: source is そうびん (そう+びん verbal tic), DS1F1#1 '그렇지로빈!'.
notes.FMsg/i_air_14#7: New 3DX choice pair リタイアする/やりなおす (DS had 하기/안 하기) → 포기하기/다시 시작 (リタイア=포기 as in DS EMesJig#21; glossary やりなおす).
notes.FMsg/i_air_14#8: Kept DS1F2#0 '벽은 아주 단단해로빈' for ガード; glossary ガード→방어 not used on purpose (DS verbatim).
notes.FMsg/i_air_14#13: Kept DS1F2#3 '벽은 아주 단단해로빈' for ガード; glossary ガード→방어 not used on purpose (DS verbatim).
notes.FMsg/i_air_14#14: Colour pair wraps only the digit 8 (same as source ８); the checker strips digits, so its colour-pair warning is expected.
notes.FMsg/i_air_14#15: Colour pair {2}..{3} wraps only the digit 8 (same as source ８); expected checker warning.
